rows.note: Use this for the everyday joint-injury sense, such as wrenching or spraining an ankle.

example.english: I accidentally wrench my ankle while playing football.
example.traditional: 我踢波嗰陣唔小心扭傷咗隻腳。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tek3 bo1 go2 zan6 m4 siu2 sam1 nau2 soeng1 zo2 zek3 goek3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for wrenching something by pulling it forcefully.

example.english: The sticker was stuck on too firmly, so I had to wrench it off.
example.traditional: 張貼紙黐得太實，我唯有硬扯落嚟。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 tip3 zi2 ci1 dak1 taai3 sat6 ngo5 wai4 jau5 ngaang6 ce2 lok6 lai4

rows.note: Use this when the forceful action is specifically a twisting movement rather than a hard pull.

example.english: They wrench the jar lid open.
example.traditional: 佢用力一扭個樽蓋，個樽蓋就開咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 lik6 jat1 nau2 go3 zeon1 goi3 go3 zeon1 goi3 zau6 hoi1 zo2
